name: app.stage-gate
description: App Studio META criterion: gate every stage transition of a web or mobile app build (intake-spec, architecture-stack, design-ux, scaffold-setup, backend-data, web-frontend, mobile, ai-features, verify-qa, ship-release, operate-learn). Input is the stage-close record: what the stage claims done and the evidence for each claim. The harness advances only when every required noul clears 0.9; DEFER when the classifier is unavailable. ADVISORY AND UNCALIBRATED until rig-s1gate calibrate runs on labelled stage records.

stage_named.instructions: The record names which App Studio stage it closes and what that stage was supposed to deliver

evidence_executed.instructions: Each completion claim cites an executed check - the command or action and the observed output, status code, or screenshot - rather than a statement of intent or a description of the code

scaffolding_as_progress.instructions: The record counts templates, stubs, placeholder screens, empty files, TODO branches, or plans as completed work

open_blockers.instructions: The record names unresolved blockers or BLOCKED checks that stop this stage from being complete

outward_without_approval.instructions: The record reports a deploy, publish, git push, purchase, or app store submission that happened without a recorded Gate-D approval

readiness.instructions: How safely can the next stage start from this record
criteria: Nothing verified: the next stage would build on guesses
Some claims verified, key ones rest on description only
Every claim verified by an executed check; next stage can start unattended

rules.reason: scaffolding or stubs counted as progress
outward or irreversible action without a recorded Gate-D approval
next stage would start on unverified ground
named blockers remain: resolve them or close the stage HELD
the record does not say which stage it closes
